Requirements: R-6
Plan row: TS-8

## Given
A guest with an empty cart; book A with stock 1000.

## Steps
For each input POST /api/cart, then GET /api/cart: quantity 0, -1, 1000, 1.5; bookId 0 and -3 with quantity 1; then quantity 1 and quantity 999 for A (separate guest sessions so the sum does not hit stock).

## Then
1. P-qty-below, P-qty-above, P-fraction: each quantity just outside the accepted range, and the fraction, gets the refusal that Q4 gives (status and VALIDATION_ERROR code).
2. P-badid: bookId 0 and a negative id get the answer that Q4 gives (not a 500).
3. P-edges: quantity 1 and quantity 999 (at each edge) get the answer that Q4 gives, and after every refusal GET /api/cart, read independently, equals the cart before the call.
